detail: Notebook remains source of truth; latestcrosssection powers cross-sectional analytics.
Existing valuation, ML, QA, scenario and dashboard logic are reused as inputs.
Finviz-inspired layer produces maps, groups, watchlists, events, macro boards, alerts and quick views.
All new outputs are table-first and exportable for Streamlit/web/API migration.
Paid-only Finviz features are approximated with local data and free-source-compatible schemas.
Unavailable data produces empty payloads with provenance/quality flags, not fabricated values.
